biotools.summary: textToKnowledgeGraph is a Python package that utilizes Large Language Models to extract molecular interactions from scientific articles and convert them into Biological Expression Language (BEL) format. It provides a command-line interface, integration within Cytoscape Web, and a dataset for fine-tuning.
